LanguageData.HE_Inti_Qullqa.label: qullqa storehouse
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Qullqa.description: A round stone storehouse with a thatched roof and vents at the floor, built where the wind blows. Food stored in it rots at half the normal speed. It holds three stacks per cell.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_QuipuTable.label: quipu table
LanguageData.HE_Inti_QuipuTable.description: A low table with a frame from which hang dozens of knotted cords in every colour, the counts of the colony. Placed near a research bench, it speeds up research by 5%.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SunStone.label: sun stone
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SunStone.description: A carved granite outcrop with a short post rising from it. On the two days of the year when the sun stands right above it, the post casts no shadow.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SunDisc.label: sun disc
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SunDisc.description: A face of the sun beaten from gold and raised on a stone stand. In the temple of the sun such discs caught the dawn and filled the hall with light.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_PumaStone.label: puma stone
LanguageData.HE_Inti_PumaStone.description: A crouching puma carved from a single block. The puma guards the world of the living, between the condor above and the serpent below.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SlingStand_Gun.label: sling arm
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SlingStand_Gun.description: The turning top of the sling stand.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SlingStand.label: sling stand
LanguageData.HE_Inti_SlingStand.description: A ring of fitted stones with a long sling arm on a pivot and a basket of round stones. It whirls three stones in a row at anyone who comes close. Feed it stone chunks: one chunk makes ten stones.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_ColdStore.label: cold store
LanguageData.HE_Inti_ColdStore.description: A stone storehouse with thick walls, a cork-lined door and an electric cooler humming in the roof. While it has power, food stored in it rots at a third of the normal speed. It holds three stacks per cell.
